per_key.analysis: Name-first «{device}: нет связи» is a natural compact connection status. The colon treats the opaque display name as a label and avoids Russian case/gender agreement, whether Latin or Cyrillic. In this remote-computer row it does not claim a phone connection error. Literal name substitutions were verified, not rendered.

«Куда переместить или скопировать» naturally introduces destination choices, preserves both operations and the exact existing переместить/скопировать verbs, and is not an action-start promise. Infinitives and sentence case match Russian UI register. Expansion is F1, not a proven truncation.

per_key.english: This app can offer the devices your sessions show. A device with no visible session cannot be picked yet — open Local Operator on the other computer and pull the list to refresh.
per_key.current_text: Приложение предлагает устройства, сессии которых видны в списке. Устройство без видимой сессии пока нельзя выбрать — откройте Local Operator на другом компьютере и потяните список сессий вниз, чтобы обновить его.
per_key.analysis: «устройства, сессии которых видны в списке» naturally explains session-derived discovery rather than a network inventory. «пока нельзя выбрать» retains the temporary selection limit. «откройте … на другом компьютере и потяните список сессий вниз, чтобы обновить его» preserves both ordered instructions and explicit pull-to-refresh gesture. Formal plural imperatives match the existing Russian instructions; Local Operator is unchanged. сессия follows binding glossary. Existing сеанс variants are pre-existing drift, not introduced mistranslations.

per_key.english: It did not answer when this computer asked.
per_key.current_text: Удалённый компьютер не ответил на запрос этого компьютера.
per_key.analysis: Explicit «Удалённый компьютер» resolves English It without dependence on a display name’s gender. «на запрос этого компьютера» accurately preserves the requesting connected relay computer, not the phone. It is calm factual past-tense fallback text. Source lines 484–485 confirm server unreachable_reason.trim() takes precedence; those reasons are not translation input. Expansion is F2.

«Другие устройства не видны.» is idiomatic factual Russian, preserves other/visible and does not assert network absence or offline status. устройство matches the glossary. No numerical count or ICU plural is required.

«На этом компьютере» is the natural current-location label, parallel to existing «На {device}» without copying a duplicate key. компьютер correctly denotes the connected relay, not the phone. No final punctuation.
«Сейчас» naturally labels the current-state section in this context; it is not an imperative or urgency instruction. Concise sentence case and no final punctuation match neighboring labels.
